Visitor orientation: 'seen from behind, no face visible' + 'walking away from the phone to the right' + 'head turned away from the camera'. Seen from behind means back to camera (walking into depth), walking right means profile; 'head turned away from the camera' is redundant or means a face-to-camera flip. A model can read it two ways, and a profile view risks a face against 'no faces'. Also 'empty calendar' in must_read_in_1s vs squares that are plain/empty by design is fine, but the viewing angle is not.
